data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for managing Windows taskbar features like progress, overlays, and toolbars.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps on Windows to control taskbar functionalities such as progress bars, thumbnail toolbars, overlay badges, window title labels, and flashing alerts. It exposes native Win32 ITaskbarList3 APIs through Dart method calls.
use_when: You are building a Windows desktop app with Flutter and need taskbar integration
You want to display download or task progress directly on the Windows taskbar icon
avoid_when: Your application targets mobile, web, or macOS/Linux platforms exclusively
You need complex UI management outside of standard Windows taskbar features
strengths: Exposes robust Win32 taskbar functionality seamlessly to Flutter
Supports progress indication, badge overlays, and custom thumbnail toolbars
weaknesses: Limited strictly to the Windows platform
Imperative API design requires manual state updates
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Works out of the box for Windows desktop targets.
